title: This Shrimp Snaps Its Claw Louder Than a Gunshot (218 dB)

scenes.text: A shrimp the size of your finger snaps its claw at 218 decibels.
That is louder than a gunshot.
The claw shoots a jet of water at about 60 miles an hour.
The jet makes a bubble that collapses in an instant, and the inside gets hotter than 4,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
It even flashes a tiny burst of light.
Small fish nearby get stunned or killed by the blast, not by the claw.
A shrimp that fires a shockwave.

description:
A shrimp the size of your finger snaps its claw at 218 decibels, louder than a gunshot.
The snap creates a bubble that collapses so fast it gets hotter than 4,000 degrees Fahrenheit and flashes light.
Would you ever dive near one?
first_comment: Which would you rather hear up close: a pistol shrimp snap or a gunshot?
